summary: Korea Electric Power Corp (KEPCO) filed a Form 6-K reporting results of an extraordinary general meeting (EGM) held on June 17, 2026. Shareholders approved the election of two standing directors (Baek, Woo-Ki and Chun, Chan-Hyuk) and two non-standing audit committee members (Jung, Do-Jin and Hwang, Jeong-Hwa). Each director received over 97% of votes cast. This filing reflects routine director elections and contains no transaction terms, premiums, or deal mechanics; it is a governance update without special-situation triggers.
